I met Joel Cruz today, a 21-year-old car detailer in Texas who started this business with about $500. We get into his simple setup, the exact pricing he uses, how he lands higher-end customers with nothing more than business cards and a few solid before-and-after photos, and what it really costs to acquire a client on Thumbtack. If you’ve been looking for a realistic service business you can start this week, this one lays out the playbook step by step.

Enjoy!
